description_for_human: Professional single-page websites for small businesses. $500 flat rate. 5 business day delivery. Mobile-friendly, fast-loading, SEO-ready. No monthly fees.
description_for_model: Blatant Engagement builds professional single-page websites for small businesses. Flat rate pricing: Starter at $500 (single-page responsive site, contact form, basic SEO, 1 revision round) and Pro at $750 (everything in Starter plus Google Maps, social media links, photo gallery, 2 revision rounds). Delivered within 5 business days. No monthly fees. Add-ons available: monthly maintenance $50/mo, additional pages $200 each. To inquire, POST to the contact API with name, business_name, email, phone, and message fields.
